definitions.explanation: The gradual process of something changing or transforming over time. Often used for seasons, eras, customs, and other things that shift naturally rather than abruptly.

examples.japanese: ⟦{季節|きせつ}→季節：01304_kisetsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{移|うつ}り{変|か}わり⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{感|かん}じる→感じる：02044_kanjiru⟧。
examples.english: I feel the changing of the seasons.

examples.japanese: ⟦{時代|じだい}→時代：01424_jidai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{移|うつ}り{変|か}わり⟦とともに→とともに：30485_totomoni⟧⟦{価値観|かちかん}→価値観：10431_kachikan⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{変|か}わる→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧。
examples.english: Values change along with the shifting of the times.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{写真集|しゃしんしゅう}→写真集：19947_shashinshuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{街|まち}→街：17306_machi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{移|うつ}り{変|か}わり⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{記録|きろく}→記録：02490_kiroku⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: This photo collection documents the transformation of the town over time.

notes:
USAGE:
{移|うつ}り{変|か}わり emphasizes gradual, natural change over time rather than sudden or deliberate change. It is often used when reflecting on how things have evolved.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{季節|きせつ}→季節：01304_kisetsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{移|うつ}り{変|か}わり: the changing of the seasons
- ⟦{時代|じだい}→時代：01424_jidai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{移|うつ}り{変|か}わり: the shifting of the times
- {移|うつ}り{変|か}わり⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{激|はげ}しい→激しい：02348_hageshii⟧: changes rapidly
- {移|うつ}り{変|か}わり⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見守|みまも}る→見守る：04574_mimamoru⟧: to watch the transition unfold

SIMILAR WORDS:
⟦{変化|へんか}→変化：03615_henka⟧ is a broader, more neutral term for change that can be sudden or gradual. {移|うつ}り{変|か}わり specifically implies a slow, natural progression and often carries a reflective or poetic tone.
